verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. create_campaign, create_event). Runnable examples come through a first-party Postman collection of pre-built requests and an importable OpenAPI spec, supported by test accounts with sample data. However, the evidence never shows the reference itself being interactive, so running examples depends on importing them into Postman. Missing for 10: evidence of in-page "try it" execution in the reference, embedded runnable code samples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
